holding <SYMBOL>_ON from open(d) to open(d+1) represents a MOC buy on d and a MOO sell on d+1; the Book charges both fills

point_in_time.derivation: base symbols copied; <SYMBOL>_ON is an overnight-leg index: ON(d+1) = ON(d) * adj_open(d+1) / adj_close(d), flat intraday
point_in_time.information_available_at: the close of the dated session
